passages.Curriculum planning: Integrating Christian principles into a learn-through-play curriculum, we prepare paths for children to step into the world with purpose and faith. Through developmentally appropriate, teacher-scaffolded, and child-initiated experiences, each child is empowered to grow in knowledge and skills at their own pace, fostering a deeper understanding of themselves, others, God, and His creation. Our thoughtfully designed Chinese Language Curriculum further allows children to deepen their appreciation of Chinese culture—the very culture in which our school is rooted and daily lived out.
passages.Learning / Teaching approach and activit: Our learning is deliberately flexible, allowing it to adapt to the individual learning patterns and developmental stages of each child. In doing so, it not only fosters rich opportunities for learning but also empowers children to reflect on their own methods, draw connections across time and place, form varied relationships, and engage with multiple points of view.

passages.Curriculum planning: The curriculum is British and covers the seven learning areas :- Communication and language ( English and Putonghua) , Literacy, Physical development, Personal and Social development, Mathematical development, Expressive art and design. Each area is implemented according to the level of the child's age and development.
passages.Learning / Teaching approach and activit: The school approaches learning through structured inquiry from the age of 3 year ( K1) which is underpinned by the Early Year Foundation Statutory framework from Great Britain. For children in Nursery (N) age 2 the school offers a thematic approach. All classes have daily Putonghua lessons with a native putonghua teacher.

passages.Curriculum planning: Our school based curriculum is especially designed to nurture our children in language, literacy and the arts. It is a curriculum based on education and developmental theories which are developmentally appropriate and on target with how young children learn best.
passages.Learning / Teaching approach and activit: Guided Discovery Approach Teachers design the school environment and select appropriate equipment to guide and stimulate children in observation, questioning and problem solving.
